historical_commentary.text: WebSTAR as a web server product is long discontinued and effectively obsolete, and 4D's own built-in web server (used for both the 4D application server and web publishing) has for many years been the standard way to serve 4D web content, making the specific WebSTAR API integration in this note obsolete for current development.
related_updates: WebSTAR as a web server product has been discontinued for many years
4D's own built-in web server has long since replaced the need for a separate WebSTAR server in 4D web deployments
